title: ammodenia major
intro: Ammodenia major, commonly known as the 'Wild Jute', is a plant species in the family Urticaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include its potential to treat fever, rheumatism, and various skin conditions. The therapeutic actions attributed to the plant are anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antiseptic, which are believed to be due to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides. The bioactive constituents in Ammodenia major are thought to possess antioxidant properties, contributing to its potential health benefits.
